snippet.title: Pacific Rim The Video Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the official gameplay trailer for Pacific Rim The Video Game ! Join us on Facebook : http://www.facebook.com/GameNewsOfficial and subscribe now : http://www.youtube.com/subscription_center?add_user=GameNewsOfficial. Take charge in eradicating the invading Kaiju !

Pacific Rim The Video Game Trailer. Release date :  July 12, 2013 (same date as the movie) on the PSN (PS3) and vXBLA (Xbox 360).
